exposure: Week of pregnancy at VTE onset
cohort: The study included 410 pregnant women who were admitted to hospital with venous thromboembolism (VTE) in Japan.
finding: Pregnancy-associated VTE exhibits a bimodal incidence, with peaks in the first and third trimesters, and is associated with risks of pulmonary embolism, recurrence, bleeding events, and maternal death.
mod_finding: Three of the four women who died during hospitalization had a history of surgical procedures, including cesarean section.
